articles.title: Todd McFarlane Returns To Spider-Man – Daily LITG, 12th December 2025
articles.summary: Todd McFarlane's return to Spider-Man emerged as Bleeding Cool's most-read story yesterday, signifying strong public interest in the popular comic character and creator. Featured in their daily 'Lying In The Gutters' roundup, this news from the comics section highlights a significant cultural happening within the entertainment sphere, attracting substantial readership on the platform.

articles.title: Akhanda 2 Review
articles.summary: The article reviews 'Akhanda 2: Thandavam,' a sequel starring Nandamuri Balakrishna and directed by Boyapati Sreenu. It suggests the film will strongly appeal to Balakrishna's fans, offering an intense action experience characteristic of Sreenu's style. The movie aims to provide a 'madcap awakening' for new audiences to their distinct cinematic approach, highlighting its impact within the national entertainment sector.

articles.title: Taron Egerton Sinks His Teeth Into Netflix UK’s Werewolf Thriller ALPHA
articles.summary: Netflix UK has successfully secured a new genre project titled "Alpha" following an intense bidding competition involving eight other contenders. Renowned actor Taron Egerton is currently being considered for a leading role in the upcoming production. This acquisition further solidifies Egerton's impressive streak of character-driven performances in his career.

articles.title: MLB's hot stove has been slow to warm. Here's 5 ways to heat it up.
articles.summary: Major League Baseball's offseason, after an encouraging start marked by semi-blockbuster deals for players like Kyle Schwarber during its winter meetings, has unexpectedly stalled. This slowdown follows an initial period of promising activity, leaving the league's further offseason developments in a state of limbo, akin to an unwelcome disruption.

articles.title: From ‘Make in India’ to ‘Design for India’: Ajay Piramal Charts a Vision for Nation-Building at Anant National University
articles.summary: Anant National University in Ahmedabad, India, held its 7th Convocation on December 12, 2025, awarding degrees to 299 students. Graduates specialized in fields like design, architecture, and sustainability. This significant event highlights academic achievement and prepares young minds for national development, mirroring the leadership and educational value emphasized for aspiring SSB candidates contributing to India's future.

articles.title: PARLIAMENT QUESTION: PHYSICAL DATA CENTRES
articles.summary: ISRO, under the Department of Space, is actively researching next-generation satellite technologies, including advanced on-board data processing capabilities. This strategic focus aims to enhance India's space capabilities and technological self-reliance. Such advancements are crucial for various applications, from communication to national security, underscoring India's commitment to leading in space innovation and strengthening its strategic assets for future challenges.
